summary.one_liner: AutoGPT is a platform for building a team of AI "Experts" (specialist agents) that Otto, a coordinating agent, can brief in plain English, with a hosted option and a self-hosted Docker option.
summary.what_it_does: The README presents AutoGPT as a system where a coordinating agent named Otto takes a task, brings in specialist Experts (such as Maria for SEO content, Max for sales research, and Frankie for executive assistant work), and returns their results. Each Expert's role can be shaped with instructions, context, skills, and connected apps, and users can create their own. A visual workflow builder lets users define repeatable steps, branch logic, and connect tools, with a marketplace of starter workflows. The README also mentions an API and MCP server for running workflows from code or an AI coding agent. Users can choose which accounts each Expert accesses, set spending controls, and review activity. The repo also contains AutoGPT Classic, the original standalone project, described as living in classic/ under MIT.
use_cases: Delegate content briefs and article drafts to an AI agent
Research sales prospects and draft outreach emails
Prepare meeting context and a daily digest with an AI assistant
Build repeatable automated workflows with a visual builder
Self-host an AI agent platform on your own infrastructure
Run agent workflows from code or an AI coding agent via API/MCP
how_to_run: docker run -d --name autogpt --restart unless-stopped --shm-size 2g --ulimit nofile=65536:65536 --log-driver json-file --log-opt max-size=50m --log-opt max-file=5 -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 -e AUTOGPT_PUBLIC_URL= -v autogpt-data:/data significantgravitas/autogpt:latest
Wait a few minutes for first boot, then open the web UI and create an account.
docker exec autogpt autogpt-admin promote you@example.com
Read the single-container self-hosting guide for requirements, ports, model providers, backups, and upgrades.
Alternatively, use the one-command installer on Linux, macOS, or Windows (per README).
For Docker Compose or source development, follow the manual self-hosting guide and autogpt_platform/ docs.
notable: Otto coordinator agent that delegates work across specialist Experts and reports back
Visual workflow builder with blocks, branching, and a workflow marketplace
API and MCP server for driving workflows from code or AI coding agents
Split licensing: autogpt_platform/ under Polyform Shield, classic/ under MIT
caveats: The hosted Platform is a paid service with plans and usage pricing; self-hosting requires your own model credentials or a local model and infrastructure management
Platform license (Polyform Shield) forbids selling it as a competing hosted service
Self-hosting requires managing updates, operations, and backups yourself
summary.license: Mixed: Polyform Shield for autogpt_platform/, MIT for classic/ and everything else
keywords: run ai team in plain english
